summary: Implemented connection-scoped Mongoose models for User, SeekerProfile, ProviderProfile, AdminProfile, and Session. Added normalized optional email/phone identity candidates with partial unique indexes without choosing the unresolved login channel, explicit account/provider states and transition guards, unique profile ownership, provider review indexes, hashed-token-only sessions with unique lookup and TTL indexes, strict schemas, optimistic concurrency for mutable account/provider state, and focused model/index/state tests. No route, authentication flow, permission behavior, public DTO, OpenAPI path, or Postman request was added; runtime inventory remains exactly GET /health and GET /ready.
